changes.summary: The tax-liability ledger (T1). Per-path rows carry taxSettled (the tax on the year's settled income), taxTrueUpPaid (last row's true-up, paid in this row; negative a refund received) and taxOutstanding (this row's true-up, owed into the next row; negative a refund due). taxes is the tax paid: this row's provisional tax plus taxTrueUpPaid. T-LIFETIME: lifetimeTaxes is sum(rows.taxSettled), the terminal outstanding included. R-NETWORTH: net worth is net of taxOutstanding. Monte Carlo rows are unchanged (a median of per-path ledger figures is deferred, as for the RMD columns). The version-4 captures r8 to r12 become known legacy captures of version 4.

changes.task: S5AA R12 round (external re-audit of b053dc2, R11-02; the owner, 2026-09-22: bump to version 4)
changes.summary: R-AGE-SPAN requires S5AA decision 8's last-death cut: where the plan's lifespans give one, the last row is that cut whether or not the result says so, and PROJECTION_ENDS_AT_LAST_DEATH must carry it (stoppedAtRowOpening the cut, lastRowAge the last row, horizonEndAge profile.endAge). The rule is frozen to version 4 and later; version 3 keeps the reading it had when its captures were taken (the disclosure, where present, names the cut; its absence means profile.endAge). No row field changes. The R11 checker applied the rule to any result checked at the latest version while the version stayed 3, and so re-judged the stored version-3 captures taken before decision 8.

Rows carry the five named income measures of TAX_RULES_ENGINE_REFERENCE_2026.md section 2.3 (federalAgi, ssProvisionalIncome, seniorDeductionMagi, niitMagi, irmaaMagi), introduced in this version and required on version-3 results only; legacy magi stays and must equal irmaaMagi (R-MAGI-ALIAS). Row fields carry introducedIn. A result is checked under the version that produced it: the engine declares RESULT_CONTRACT_VERSION, a capture records it as meta.resultContractVersion, the stored captures that predate it are version 2 by the provenance listed under legacyCaptures, and anything else is refused (S-CONTRACT-VERSION). Arizona AGI is not a row field.

Closes the four checker gaps the S2 closeout verdict witnessed. T-FINITE: numeric top-level values must be finite. S-ROW-RECORD: a row must be a non-null object, reported, never thrown. M-PATHS: path counts are positive integers, and the plan-dependent half is reported as skipped without a plan. X-INVALID: path counts on an invalid result are integers where present. No field changed meaning.

scope: P5-02's intended-result contract: the shape, types, meanings, units, nominal/real bases, per-mode differences and structural/reconciliation invariants of a runPlan() result. It does NOT certify financial values (tax amounts, success rates). Accepted scope: S2_S3_CLOSEOUT_ANSWERS_20260912.md CQ-1a/1b. Human-readable form and full source citations: RESULT_CONTRACT.md.

age.meaning: Opening row: the plan's starting age. Every other row: the age at the END of the interval it covers.

contributions.meaning: Employee plus employer contributions deposited during the interval.

income.meaning: Outside income plus wages received during the interval (see conflict C2).

dividends.meaning: Dividend cash paid out of the portfolio during the interval.

taxes.meaning: Taxes plus penalties for the interval.

rmd.meaning: Required minimum distribution OWED for the interval.

rmdUnmet.meaning: Required minimum distribution owed but not distributed.

shortfall.meaning: Spending that eligible sources could not fund.

debtPayments.meaning: Debt payments falling in the RETIREMENT period of the interval only (see conflict C3).

debtPaymentsTotal.meaning: All debt payments during the interval, working and retired.

debtHousing.meaning: Housing-cost portion of debtPaymentsTotal (taxes, insurance, HOA, PMI).

inflationFactor.meaning: Cumulative price level since the start; 1 on the opening row.

networth.meaning: Portfolio plus, when net worth is on, other assets less debt plus insurance.

magi.meaning: Modified adjusted gross income for the interval: the IRMAA measure. From version 3 it is also reported as irmaaMagi and must equal it (R-MAGI-ALIAS).

federalAgi.meaning: Federal AGI for the interval: ordinary income (net of the deductible half of self-employment tax) plus investment income plus federally taxable Social Security (TAX section 2.3, federal_agi). Opening row: 0, as every interval flow. Monte Carlo rows: the median across valid paths, taken independently.

ssProvisionalIncome.meaning: Social Security provisional (comparison) income: ordinary plus investment income plus half the benefits (IRS Publication 915; TAX section 2.3, ss_provisional_income). It is not AGI. Opening row: 0, as every interval flow. Monte Carlo rows: the median across valid paths, taken independently.

seniorDeductionMagi.meaning: MAGI for the senior deduction: AGI plus the section 911/931/933 exclusions, none of which is modelled, so equal to federalAgi (TAX section 2.3, senior_deduction_magi). Opening row: 0, as every interval flow. Monte Carlo rows: the median across valid paths, taken independently.

niitMagi.meaning: MAGI for the net investment income tax: AGI plus the section 911 exclusion, not modelled, so equal to federalAgi (TAX section 2.3, niit_magi). Opening row: 0, as every interval flow. Monte Carlo rows: the median across valid paths, taken independently.

irmaaMagi.meaning: MAGI for Medicare IRMAA, the lookback measure (TAX section 2.3, irmaa_magi); equal to magi (R-MAGI-ALIAS). Opening row: 0, as every interval flow. Monte Carlo rows: the median across valid paths, taken independently.

taxSettled.meaning: The tax on the year's SETTLED income: the whole return re-figured at the row's end with each owner's Form 8606 settlement (workstream A), plus the row's penalties. Equals the provisional tax (taxes - taxTrueUpPaid) where no owner holds IRA basis or a post-70.5 QCD offset. Opening row: 0.

taxTrueUpPaid.meaning: The previous row's taxOutstanding, paid in this row: owed tax funded like any other obligation, or (negative) a refund received as outside cash. Opening row: 0.

taxOutstanding.meaning: This row's true-up, taxSettled less the provisional tax this row funded: owed into the next row (negative: a refund due). On the last row it has no next row; it comes off net worth, and where the portfolio left cannot pay it the unpaid part is that row's shortfall. Opening row: 0.

calculationError.meaning: Whether this row hit a calculation error. Non-opening rows only.

calculationErrorCode.meaning: The row's calculation-error code, or null. Non-opening rows only.

q10.meaning: 10th percentile of total across valid paths.

q90.meaning: 90th percentile of total across valid paths.

calculationError.meaning: Whether any path hit a calculation error at this row.

monteCarlo.meaning: Every field except age, q10, q90 and calculationError is the MEDIAN of that field taken independently across valid paths. Medians of components need not come from the same path as the median of the total, so no additive per-path invariant applies (S-Q40).

firstShortfallAge.meaning: median across valid paths that had one

sustainedFailureAge.meaning: median across valid paths that had one

identity.meaning: Attached by runScenario(), not runPlan(); null for SCENARIO_NONSERIALIZABLE_INPUT (Q48) and SCENARIO_UNREADABLE_INPUT (S5R-01).

calculationErrorAge.meaning: Invalid results: the age of the first calculation error in a simple/historical run; null for a pre-simulation rejection; absent on a Monte Carlo aggregate.

invariants.rule: every numeric row field is finite

every numeric top-level value that is present, required or optional, is finite; a nullable numeric (number|null) is checked when non-null. Added at version 2: typeof NaN is 'number', so a type check alone admitted NaN and Infinity (BC-01)

every element of rows is a non-null, non-array object; anything else is a structural violation at its index, and the whole-result invariants that need every row are reported as skipped. Added at version 2: a null row threw a TypeError instead of being reported (BC-01)
row ages strictly increase

rows[0].age === profile.age, and the last row's age === profile.endAge -- or, where the plan's lifespans give one, the last-death cut (S5AA decision 8): the first row opening at which nobody the plan models is alive, as the checker derives it from the plan, never from the result's own claim. From contract VERSION 4 (frozen there, not tied to whichever version is current) a result must meet that cut whether or not it says anything, and must carry PROJECTION_ENDS_AT_LAST_DEATH naming it: stoppedAtRowOpening is the cut, lastRowAge is the result's last row, horizonEndAge is profile.endAge. Under versions 2 and 3 -- what the captures taken before decision 8 recorded -- the disclosure selects the reading as it did, and its absence means profile.endAge, so no stored capture is re-judged.
the opening row has inflationFactor 1, realTotal === total, and zero interval flows
realTotal === total / inflationFactor. For Monte Carlo this holds only while inflation is non-stochastic across paths; if that changes, this invariant must be re-derived, not relaxed.
total === taxable + preTax + roth + hsa (accounts with a valid taxClass)

networth === total + (networthOn ? otherAssets - debtBalance + (age >= retirement.selfLife ? advanced.insurance : 0) : 0), less taxOutstanding from version 5 (a true-up owed is a liability, a refund due an asset)
debtPaymentsTotal === debtInterest + debtPrincipal + debtHousing
rmdUnmet === max(0, rmd - rmdDistributed)
shortfall >= 0, inflationFactor > 0, and rmdUnmet >= 0 where present

lifetimeTaxes === sum(rows.taxes) through version 4, and sum(rows.taxSettled) from version 5; lifetimeContributions === sum(rows.contributions); lifetimeContributionsReal === sum(rows.contributions / max(0.0001, inflationFactor))

firstShortfallAge is the age of the first row with shortfall > 0.01, else null; sustainedFailureAge is the age of the second row in the first run of consecutive such rows, else null; failureAge === sustainedFailureAge
failed === rows.some(shortfall > 0.01) and successRate === (failed ? 0 : 100)

requestedPathCount and validPathCount are positive integers; validPathCount === requestedPathCount, calculationErrorPaths === 0, and requestedPathCount === assumptions.runs where the plan is known -- without a plan that last part is reported as skipped (M-PATHS:runs). Positive integers and the skip report added at version 2 (BC-01)
0 <= successRate <= 100 and failed === (successRate < 100)
q10 <= total <= q90 on every row

the financial fields listed under topLevel.invalid are null, rows is null, and partialDiagnostics carries a label; where an invalid Monte Carlo result carries path counts they are integers >= 0, and requestedPathCount >= 1 (added at version 2, BC-01)

a result is checked under one supported contract version (supportedVersions); a row field applies from its introducedIn version (absent means every supported version). An unsupported, missing or malformed version is refused before any other rule, never checked under the most permissive schema. A capture's version is meta.resultContractVersion, or, for a capture that records none, the version its provenance under legacyCaptures gives; the absence of the new fields is never evidence of an older version.

invariants.applies: ok, all modes, every row, version 3 onward
invariants.rule: magi === irmaaMagi exactly: magi is the IRMAA measure it always reported, kept for compatibility
every required key is present with its type; any key not in the contract (required or optional) is reported as unspecified

legacyCaptures.why: Stored format-3 captures taken before version 3 record no result-contract version. Each is recognised by its commit and output hash, not by the absence of the new fields, and is checked under version 2. A capture that records no version and is not listed here is refused. A capture that records a version older than the producer's is accepted only if it is listed here with that version (R10, provisional). R12 round (R11-02): an entry may name its own contractVersion; one that names none is the default above, version 2. The seven stored S5AA expanded captures recorded version 3 when version 3 was the producer's; now that the producer is version 4 they are listed here, by commit and output hash, so each is judged under the version it was produced under, and a current result cannot claim version 3 without matching one of them.

tolerance: numeric equality within max(0.01, 1e-9 * |expected|), the reconciliation tolerance checkRowInvariants already uses
